name: memory-match-master
description: A high-performance Memory Match game with a Neon Arcade theme, featuring a FastAPI backend and a React/Vite frontend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "make -C backend dev" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix frontend && make -C backend test
scripts.lint: make -C backend lint && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && make -C backend install
